versions.content: Abstraction of FOTA Target ECU internal memory layout. 10 of 20  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 944: AUTOSAR_RS_FirmwareOverTheAir Requirements on Firmware Over-The-Air AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Type: draft Description: The FOTA Handler shall abstract the FOTA Target ECU internal memory layout from the FOTA Master ECU. Rationale: It shall be possible for the FOTA Master ECU to always operate on identical memory addresses or logically represented memory blocks, when installing a new software, regardless on which physical addresses in FOTA Target ECU data will be finally written. Dependencies: Use Case: Reduce the complexity of FOTA Master ECU by abstraction of internal memory layout of FOTA Target ECUs. Supporting Material:
